import itertools
def solve(g):
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(7) for c in range(7) if g[r][c]==8]
    cellset=set(cells)
    # generate pieces: 2x2 square and L triominoes fully inside shape
    pieces=[]
    for r in range(6):
        for c in range(6):
            blk=[(r+i,c+j) for i in(0,1) for j in(0,1)]
            inside=[p for p in blk if p in cellset]
            if len(inside)==4: pieces.append((frozenset(blk),'sq',None))
            elif len(inside)==3:
                miss=[p for p in blk if p not in inside][0]
                # missing corner relative to block: TL,TR,BL,BR
                code={(0,0):2,(0,1):4,(1,0):3,(1,1):5}[ (miss[0]-r,miss[1]-c) ]
                pieces.append((frozenset(inside),'tri',code))
    sols=[]
    def bt(rem,used,acc):
        if not rem:
            sols.append(list(acc)); return
        p0=min(rem)
        for piece,col,code in pieces:
            if p0 in piece and piece<=rem:
                bt(rem-piece,used,acc+[(piece,col,code)])
    bt(frozenset(cells),0,[])
    return sols
